burnt_sugar.name: The Smell of Burnt Sugar
burnt_sugar.description: Mara burned the first batch and laughed. You kept the laugh.

steady_hand.name: Iven's Steady Hand
steady_hand.description: He does not miss. More importantly, he does not hurry.

backwards_bell.name: The Bell That Rings Backwards
backwards_bell.description: A note played in reverse. The dark answers a beat too late.

ash_lung.name: Ash in the Lungs
ash_lung.description: You learn to breathe where the air has learned to burn.

iven_mark.name: A Mark at Fifty Paces
iven_mark.description: Iven's signal, scratched into a beam. He trusts you to look up.

counterweight.name: The Counterweight
counterweight.description: The foundry taught you where to stand when the floor begins to fall.

ninth_step.name: The Ninth Step
ninth_step.description: There is a stair in the Spire that only appears when you stop counting.
ninth_step.effect: +1 attack and +1 speed to the party.

quiet_room.name: A Room With No Bell
quiet_room.description: For one hour, the city was allowed to be ordinary.

cracked_brass.name: Cracked Brass
cracked_brass.description: The flaw is not the end of the Bell. It is the part that remembers.
cracked_brass.effect: +5 max HP and +1 attack to the party.
